messages.subject: value_type vs scalar_type
parts:
Both stan::math::value_type & stan::scalar_type seem to do the same
thing.

Is there a good reason that there are two ways to do the same thing?

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] value_type vs scalar_type
parts:
Thanks for the heads up. We should eliminate one. I created
an issue:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/1211

This one was my bad --- I refactored some injected matrix
code into value_type and didn't realize scalar_type already
did what I needed.
